description: This file defines the 'BuzzLikeOnShareSearchFilterParams' class, which extends a base filter parameters class to provide specific filtering options (particularly for share ID and sorting) related to 'likes' on shares in the OrangeHRM Buzz module.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class used for filtering search results related to 'likes' on shared items in the Buzz module, supporting sorting by 'likedAtUtc' and filtering by 'shareId'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'shareLike.likedAtUtc'.
